text:
maria: Heads-up: reproducible cancel leak in Go generator sample app. Cancelling ctx mid-stream sometimes leaves a background sender goroutine alive and later we get panic on write to closed socket.
kevin: can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: simplified snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1*time.Second)
defer cancel()
g := client.NewGenerator()
str, err := g.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
go func() { for t := range str.Tokens() { _ = t } }()
// on ctx.Done() some runs: Tokens() never closes, goroutine leaks, later panic
```
paul: could be transport-level write blocking during auth refresh or TLS stalls. If ctx is canceled the higher layers may not notice.
sophia: current SDK patterns are inconsistent: some streaming APIs return closed channels on cancel, others return Err() errors. We should unify.
kevin: proposal: guarantee Stream(ctx) either closes Tokens() or makes Err() return context.Canceled quickly. Add stream.Close() semantics and CloseWithErr(err) for surfaced reasons.
paul: also add generator.Abort(ctx) to signal server to stop work (avoid wasting GPU cycles).
ryan: short-term mitigation: add write timeouts on the transport so blocked writes don't hang forever. Long-term: ensure token refresh honors ctx and returns error upstream.
maria: CI flaky test: TestGeneratorCancelLeak (2/7) reported by ci-bot.
ci-bot: test/linux-amd64: TestGeneratorCancelLeak flaky (2/7)  https://ci.internal/reports/17688/TestGeneratorCancelLeak
kevin: docs UX: sample apps currently use context.Background() in examples which encourages ignoring cancellation. Let's update examples to show proper ctx usage + defer stream.Close().
sophia: I'll draft docs changes once API shape is agreed. also we should add an integration test that simulates slow network + immediate cancel.
paul: auth team FYI: if retries swallow ctx cancellations during token refresh we get duplicate inflight work. Need to ensure retry loop propagates ctx error immediately.
maria: action items:
- maria: open issue with logs + minimal repro + CI links
- kevin & paul: review API change (Close()/CloseWithErr()/Abort())
- sophia: update sample app/docs after API lock
- ryan: add transport write timeouts as a mitigation
ci-bot: issue created: https://issues.internal/RED-2345
maria: I'll open a PR with a small integration test and the sample app change once we agree on API. :thumbsup:
